## Saved models gallery in Windows 0.24.31

The bottom of Sculptor’s Bench now presents saved models in a three-column gallery with the model name under each thumbnail. Selecting a model updates the interactive preview, highlights its tile with cyan corners and puts its name beside Export GLB. The export uses the selected revision. The Saved Models area no longer offers Open saved scene editor.

Each page shows up to six actual saved models. Visible thumbnails render one at a time from their stored GLBs. A bounded in-memory cache holds up to 64 small thumbnail images keyed by workspace, model and revision. Wider and narrower windows use three, two or one column.

## Saved models gallery, Windows 0.24.31

Compared the packaged Windows gallery against the selected third mockup. The dark background, serif heading and rule, two rows of wide model thumbnails with captions, cyan selection corners and bottom export action match the chosen design. The user requested removal of the editor link. The pagination row appears for libraries with more than six items. Thumbnail content comes from the saved files.

Tested an empty library, then seven model fixtures in an isolated workspace profile. The gallery rendered six distinct thumbnails, paged to the seventh model, returned to the first page and kept long titles inside the layout. Tested selection on both generated and scene-model records with an existing scene draft present. Verified the editor link was absent and a native Save As export matched the selected GLB byte-for-byte. The 1552-pixel desktop capture showed three columns, and 960- and 650-pixel windows showed two columns without gallery overflow.

Final result: passed.
